title: Fox Corp to acquire Roku in $22B deal
title_zh: 福克斯公司将以 22B 美元的交易收购 Roku
summary: Fox Corp (NASDAQ:FOXA) has agreed to acquire streaming platform Roku Inc (NASDAQ:ROKU) in a cash-and-stock deal valuing the company at approximately $22 billion in enterprise value, the companies announced Monday.
summary_zh: 福克斯公司（纳斯达克股票代码：FOXA）周一宣布，已同意以现金加股票的方式收购流媒体平台 Roku Inc（纳斯达克股票代码：ROKU），该公司的企业价值约为 220 亿美元。

title: Salesforce Stock Rises as $3.6 Billion Deal for AI Company Eases Software Fears
title_zh: 人工智能公司 36 亿美元的交易缓解了软件担忧，Salesforce 股价上涨
summary: Salesforce stock rises after the software company announces a $3.6 billion deal to bolster its AI agent offerings.
summary_zh: 在软件公司 Salesforce 宣布达成一项 36 亿美元的交易以增强其人工智能代理产品后，该公司股价上涨。

title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jumps 600 Points On U.S.-Iran Deal; Chip Companies, Boeing Take Off (Live Coverage)
title_zh: 今日股市：美国与伊朗达成协议，道琼斯指数上涨 600 点；芯片公司，波音起飞（现场报道）
summary: Stock Market Today: The Dow Jones index rallied 600 points Monday on the U.S.-Iran deal. Oil prices dived below $80 a barrel.
summary_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数周一因美国与伊朗达成协议而上涨 600 点。油价跌破每桶 80 美元。

title: Dow hits record high on Iran deal optimism, lower oil prices
title_zh: 道琼斯指数因伊朗协议乐观和油价下跌而创历史新高
summary: By Twesha Dikshit and Joel Jose June 15 (Reuters) - Wall Street's main indexes rose on Monday, with the Dow touching an intraday high after the United States and Iran struck a preliminary agreement to
summary_zh: 路透 6 月 15 日 - 华尔街主要股指周一上涨，道琼斯指数在美国和伊朗达成初步协议后触及盘中高点。

title: Oil prices sink, stocks soar after Trump announces deal with Iran
title_zh: 特朗普宣布与伊朗达成协议后油价下跌，股市飙升
summary: Markets rally on expectations that the agreement will ease global energy supply concerns, though analysts warn gas prices may remain elevated for some time.
summary_zh: 市场因预期该协议将缓解全球能源供应担忧而上涨，尽管分析师警告天然气价格可能在一段时间内保持高位。
